description: AI Laser Scanner Master 145 Candlestick Patterns & Technical Confluence Knowledge Base

patterns.name: Doji Star (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Long red candle followed by a gap-down Doji. Rejection of sellers and bullish reversal signal.

patterns.name: Doji Star (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Long green candle followed by a gap-up Doji. Exhaustion of buyers and bearish reversal signal.

patterns.name: Doji Star (Upward Continuation)
patterns.rule: Doji forming during healthy uptrend pullback, quickly followed by green breakout continuing upward momentum.

patterns.name: Doji Star (Downward Continuation)
patterns.rule: Doji forming during downtrend rest pause, followed by strong red breakdown continuation.

patterns.name: Southern Doji
patterns.rule: Doji located at the lowest extreme of a prolonged downtrend, indicating seller exhaustion.

patterns.name: Northern Doji
patterns.rule: Doji located at the highest peak of an uptrend, signaling buyer exhaustion and bearish turn.

patterns.name: Long-Legged Doji (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Extremely long upper and lower shadows with equal open/close at support, buyers defending aggressively.

patterns.name: Long-Legged Doji (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Large high/low volatility wick at resistance with flat body, high probability bearish reversal.

patterns.name: Long-Legged Doji (Upward Continuation)
patterns.rule: High volatility doji absorbing seller supply followed by strong green candle continuation.

patterns.name: Long-Legged Doji (Downward Continuation)
patterns.rule: High volatility doji failing to break upper resistance, continuing strong downward trend.

patterns.name: Tri-Star (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Three consecutive doji candles with the middle one gapping lower, strong bullish reversal.

patterns.name: Tri-Star (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Three consecutive doji candles with middle one gapping higher, strong bearish reversal.

patterns.name: Abandoned Baby (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Large red candle, gap down doji completely isolated, followed by gap up green candle.

patterns.name: Abandoned Baby (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Large green candle, gap up isolated doji, followed by gap down red candle.

patterns.name: Island Reversal (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Cluster of candles isolated by exhaustion gap down and breakaway gap up.

patterns.name: Island Reversal (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Cluster of candles isolated by gap up and breakaway gap down, sharp drop incoming.

patterns.name: Morning Star
patterns.rule: 3-candle pattern: large red candle + small star body + strong green candle closing deep into the first red.

patterns.name: Evening Star
patterns.rule: 3-candle pattern: large green candle + small star body + strong red candle closing deep into the first green.

patterns.name: Morning Doji Star
patterns.rule: Large red candle + gap-down doji star + strong green close, higher confidence bullish reversal.

patterns.name: Evening Doji Star
patterns.rule: Large green candle + gap-up doji star + strong red close, higher confidence bearish reversal.

patterns.name: Spinning Top (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Small green body with symmetrical upper and lower wicks at support indicating seller pressure loss.

patterns.name: Spinning Top (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Small red body with symmetrical upper and lower wicks at resistance indicating buyer exhaustion.

patterns.name: Spinning Top (Upward Continuation)
patterns.rule: Spinning top serving as brief resting pause within a solid uptrend, continuing upward on breakout.

patterns.name: Spinning Top (Downward Continuation)
patterns.rule: Spinning top serving as brief pause within a dominant downtrend, followed by downward continuation.

patterns.name: Dragonfly Doji (Bullish)
patterns.rule: T-shaped candle with no upper wick and very long lower shadow rejecting support.

patterns.name: Dragonfly Doji (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Dragonfly doji failing to maintain high, followed by red candle closing below its low.

patterns.name: Gravestone Doji (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Inverted T-shaped candle with long upper shadow and no lower shadow at resistance, strong seller push.

patterns.name: Gravestone Doji (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Gravestone doji at major support where buyers absorb selling pressure and reclaim higher levels.

patterns.name: Harami (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Large red candle followed by a small green candle completely inside the red candle's body.

patterns.name: Harami (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Large green candle followed by a small red candle completely inside the green candle's body.

patterns.name: Harami Cross (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Large red candle followed by a doji completely engulfed within the red body. High volatility turn.

patterns.name: Harami Cross (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Large green candle followed by a doji completely engulfed within the green body. Exhaustion turn.

patterns.name: Homing Pigeon
patterns.rule: Large red candle followed by a smaller red candle contained inside its body at key support.

patterns.name: Descending Hawk
patterns.rule: Large green candle followed by a smaller green candle contained inside its body at key resistance.

patterns.name: Squeeze Alert (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Tight candle contraction followed by explosive green expansion candle breaking out.

patterns.name: Squeeze Alert (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Tight candle contraction followed by explosive red expansion candle breaking down.

patterns.name: Unique Three River Bottom
patterns.rule: 3 candles: Long red, followed by lower-shadow hammer red, followed by small green candle.

patterns.name: Upside Gap Two Crows
patterns.rule: Strong green, gap up black candle, followed by second black candle engulfing the first black body.

patterns.name: Three Inside Up
patterns.rule: Bullish Harami followed by a 3rd strong green candle closing above the 1st red candle's high.

patterns.name: Three Inside Down
patterns.rule: Bearish Harami followed by a 3rd strong red candle closing below the 1st green candle's low.

patterns.name: Hammer
patterns.rule: Small body at top with long lower shadow (2-3x body) rejecting lower prices at support.

patterns.name: Hanging Man
patterns.rule: Small body at top with long lower shadow at key resistance indicating sellers testing lower prices.

patterns.name: Inverted Hammer
patterns.rule: Small body at bottom with long upper shadow at support indicating buyers aggressively testing higher levels.

patterns.name: Shooting Star
patterns.rule: Small body at bottom with long upper wick rejecting resistance, high probability sell signal.

patterns.name: Pin Bar (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Sharp rejection wick piercing support zone with strong buyer close at the high.

patterns.name: Pin Bar (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Sharp rejection wick piercing resistance zone with strong seller close at the low.

patterns.name: Engulfing (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Small red candle completely covered and engulfed by a subsequent large green candle.

patterns.name: Engulfing (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Small green candle completely covered and engulfed by a subsequent large red candle.

patterns.name: Three Outside Up
patterns.rule: Bullish Engulfing pattern confirmed by a 3rd green candle closing higher than the engulfing high.

patterns.name: Three Outside Down
patterns.rule: Bearish Engulfing pattern confirmed by a 3rd red candle closing lower than the engulfing low.

patterns.name: Inside Day
patterns.rule: Candle completely inside previous candle's high/low followed by strong green upside breakout.

patterns.name: Outside Day
patterns.rule: Candle completely engulfing previous range from high to low, breaking down lower.

patterns.name: Hook Reversal (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Inside day formation at downtrend bottom where low stays above previous low and reverses upward.

patterns.name: Hook Reversal (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Inside day formation at uptrend top where high stays below previous high and reverses downward.

patterns.name: Piercing Line
patterns.rule: Large red candle followed by green candle opening lower and closing above 50% of the red body.

patterns.name: Dark Cloud Cover
patterns.rule: Large green candle followed by red candle opening higher and closing below 50% of the green body.

patterns.name: Above the Stomach
patterns.rule: Green candle opens at or above the midpoint of the preceding black candle and closes higher.

patterns.name: Below the Stomach
patterns.rule: Red candle opens at or below the midpoint of preceding white candle and closes lower.

patterns.name: Thrusting Line (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Strong green thrust penetrating deep into prior resistance, signaling buyer dominance.

patterns.name: Thrusting Line (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Green candle attempts rally but fails to close above midpoint of previous black body, sellers resume.

patterns.name: Big White Candle
patterns.rule: Very large green candle body significantly exceeding average candle size, extreme buyer momentum.

patterns.name: Big Black Candle
patterns.rule: Very large red candle body significantly exceeding average candle size, extreme seller momentum.

patterns.name: White Marubozu
patterns.rule: Solid green candle with no upper or lower wicks (open=low, close=high), 100% buyer dominance.

patterns.name: Black Marubozu
patterns.rule: Solid red candle with no upper or lower wicks (open=high, close=low), 100% seller dominance.

patterns.name: Open Marubozu (White)
patterns.rule: Green candle opens immediately at lowest price (no lower wick) and rallies with small upper wick.

patterns.name: Open Marubozu (Black)
patterns.rule: Red candle opens immediately at highest price (no upper wick) and plummets with small lower wick.

patterns.name: Close Marubozu (White)
patterns.rule: Green candle closes right at its high (no upper wick) confirming buyer persistence into the next minute.

patterns.name: Close Marubozu (Black)
patterns.rule: Red candle closes right at its low (no lower wick) confirming seller persistence into the next minute.

patterns.name: Belt Hold (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Opens at session low after downtrend, surges upward throughout the period to close near its high.

patterns.name: Belt Hold (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Opens at session high after uptrend, drops downward relentlessly to close near its low.

patterns.name: Concealing Baby Swallow (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Four-candle pattern of consecutive black marubozus culminating in final engulfing black candle, reversal next.

patterns.name: Concealing Baby Swallow (Bearish Continuation)
patterns.rule: Heavy downward volume sequence piercing multiple support barriers with bearish continuation.

patterns.name: Tweezer Bottom
patterns.rule: Two consecutive candles touching the exact same low price level with bottom wicks, double rejection.

patterns.name: Tweezer Top
patterns.rule: Two consecutive candles touching the exact same high price level with top wicks, double rejection.

patterns.name: Matching Low
patterns.rule: Two black candles closing at the exact identical low price, firm support floor established.

patterns.name: Matching High
patterns.rule: Two white candles closing at the exact identical high price, firm resistance barrier established.

patterns.name: Stick Sandwich (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Green candle sandwiched between two red candles that have equal closing prices.

patterns.name: Stick Sandwich (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Red candle sandwiched between two green candles that have equal high prices.

patterns.name: Gap Up / Rising Window
patterns.rule: Price gaps up leaving an unfilled price space between previous high and current low. Window acts as support.

patterns.name: Gap Down / Falling Window
patterns.rule: Price gaps down leaving unfilled price space between previous low and current high. Window acts as resistance.

patterns.name: High Price Gapping Play
patterns.rule: Strong green candle, small high consolidation candles, followed by strong gap up green breakout.

patterns.name: Low Price Gapping Play
patterns.rule: Strong red candle, small low consolidation candles, followed by strong gap down red breakdown.

patterns.name: Breakaway (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Long red, gap down followed by 3 downward drifting candles, then a big green candle closing into the gap.

patterns.name: Breakaway (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Long green, gap up followed by 3 upward drifting candles, then a big red candle closing into the gap.

patterns.name: Tower Bottom
patterns.rule: One long red candle, small basing candles along the floor, followed by an equally tall green tower candle.

patterns.name: Tower Top
patterns.rule: One long green candle, small topping candles along the ceiling, followed by an equally tall red tower candle.

patterns.name: Fry Pan Bottom
patterns.rule: Gentle rounding bottom of small candles completed by a gap up green candle breakout.

patterns.name: Dumpling Top
patterns.rule: Gentle rounding top of small candles completed by a gap down red candle breakdown.

patterns.name: Upside Tasuki Gap
patterns.rule: Green candle gaps up from prior green candle, followed by red candle opening inside and closing inside gap without filling it.

patterns.name: Downside Tasuki Gap
patterns.rule: Red candle gaps down from prior red candle, followed by green candle opening inside and failing to fill the gap.

patterns.name: Upside Gap Three Methods
patterns.rule: Two green candles separated by rising gap, third red candle fills the gap and tests support before uptrend resumes.

patterns.name: Downside Gap Three Methods
patterns.rule: Two red candles separated by falling gap, third green candle fills the gap before downtrend resumes.

patterns.name: Deliberation (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Steady upward stepping candles absorbing selling pressure and maintaining buyer control.

patterns.name: Deliberation (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Two strong long green candles followed by a third small body star, signaling rally exhaustion.

patterns.name: Side by Side White Lines (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Green candle gaps up above first green candle, next candle opens at same level and also closes green.

patterns.name: Side by Side White Lines (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Two green candles gap down together below red candle, representing weak counter-trend bounce doomed to fail.

patterns.name: Bullish Kicking
patterns.rule: Black marubozu followed by gap up white marubozu leaving a wide gap. Instant sentiment flip.

patterns.name: Bearish Kicking
patterns.rule: White marubozu followed by gap down black marubozu leaving a wide gap. Instant crash sentiment.

patterns.name: Rising Three Methods
patterns.rule: Long green candle followed by 3 small red candles staying within its range, then strong 5th green candle closing at new high.

patterns.name: Falling Three Methods
patterns.rule: Long red candle followed by 3 small green candles staying within its range, then strong 5th red candle closing at new low.

patterns.name: Mat Hold (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Long green, gap up with 3 small red pullbacks holding above 1st candle low, followed by powerful green breakout.

patterns.name: Mat Hold (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Long red, gap down with 3 small green pullbacks holding below 1st candle high, followed by powerful red breakdown.

patterns.name: Ladder Bottom
patterns.rule: 3 consecutive red candles, 4th red candle with small body and long upper wick, 5th candle gaps up into strong green.

patterns.name: Ladder Top
patterns.rule: 3 consecutive green candles, 4th green candle with small body and long lower wick, 5th candle gaps down into strong red.

patterns.name: One White Soldier
patterns.rule: First decisive green candle breaking through the high of preceding red downtrend candles.

patterns.name: One Black Crow
patterns.rule: First decisive red candle breaking through the low of preceding green uptrend candles.

patterns.name: Two Rabbits
patterns.rule: Two small green candles holding the support line together during an ascending rally.

patterns.name: Two Crows
patterns.rule: Long green candle followed by two consecutive black candles closing lower and signaling reversal.

patterns.name: Three Whites Soldiers
patterns.rule: Three consecutive large green candles opening within previous body and closing near new consecutive highs.

patterns.name: Three Black Crows
patterns.rule: Three consecutive large red candles opening within previous body and closing near new consecutive lows.

patterns.name: Identical Three Soldiers
patterns.rule: Three green candles where each opens exactly at the previous candle's close, extreme buyer continuity.

patterns.name: Identical Three Crows
patterns.rule: Three red candles where each opens exactly at the previous candle's close, extreme seller continuity.

patterns.name: Descent Block
patterns.rule: Three consecutive red candles with progressively smaller bodies and lengthening lower wicks, selling drying up.

patterns.name: Advance Block
patterns.rule: Three consecutive green candles with progressively smaller bodies and lengthening upper wicks, buying drying up.

patterns.name: Three Line Strike (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Three descending red candles completely wiped out and engulfed by a single monster green strike candle.

patterns.name: Three Line Strike (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Three ascending green candles completely wiped out and engulfed by a single monster red strike candle.

patterns.name: Three Stars in the South
patterns.rule: Three black candles: long black with lower shadow, smaller black with lower low, small black marubozu. Exhaustion.

patterns.name: Three Stars in the North
patterns.rule: Three white candles with diminishing bodies and top wicks, buyers completely exhausted.

patterns.name: In Neck
patterns.rule: In downtrend, green candle closes just slightly inside or at the low of preceding red candle body, bears resume.

patterns.name: On Neck
patterns.rule: In downtrend, green candle closes exactly at the close of preceding red candle, bears immediately resume downward push.

patterns.name: Separating Lines (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Red candle followed by green candle that opens at the exact same open price as the red candle, resuming uptrend.

patterns.name: Separating Lines (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Green candle followed by red candle that opens at the exact same open price as the green candle, resuming downtrend.

patterns.name: Meeting Lines (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Long black candle followed by long green candle closing at the exact same closing price as the black candle.

patterns.name: Meeting Lines (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Long white candle followed by long red candle closing at the exact same closing price as the white candle.

patterns.name: Counter Attack Line (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Deep gap down open followed by immediate violent surge back to prior candle close.

patterns.name: Counter Attack Line (Bearish)
patterns.rule: High gap up open followed by immediate violent drop back to prior candle close.

patterns.name: Eight Candle Reversal (Bullish)
patterns.rule: 8 consecutive consecutive red candles exhausting downward momentum, mathematical high-probability reversal.

patterns.name: Eight Candle Reversal (Bearish)
patterns.rule: 8 consecutive green candles exhausting upward momentum, mathematical high-probability reversal.

patterns.name: Mat Hold (Bullish Extended)
patterns.rule: Institutional grade mat hold continuation with elevated volume breakout above consolidation.

patterns.name: Mat Hold (Bearish Extended)
patterns.rule: Institutional grade mat hold breakdown with elevated selling volume below consolidation.

patterns.name: Ladder Bottom (Extended)
patterns.rule: Multi-candle descending staircase exhausted at major Fibonacci support level.

patterns.name: Ladder Top (Extended)
patterns.rule: Multi-candle ascending staircase exhausted at major Fibonacci resistance level.

patterns.name: One White Soldier (Extended)
patterns.rule: Strong green impulse candle confirming higher low structure and trend shift.

patterns.name: One Black Crow (Extended)
patterns.rule: Strong red impulse candle confirming lower high structure and trend shift.

patterns.name: Two Rabbits (Extended)
patterns.rule: Twin bullish consolidation candles bouncing cleanly off the 21 EMA line.

patterns.name: Two Crows (Extended)
patterns.rule: Twin bearish rejection candles failing at the 21 EMA resistance line.

patterns.name: Three Whites Soldiers (Extended)
patterns.rule: High momentum consecutive green expansion bars clearing all local resistance.

patterns.name: Three Black Crows (Price Action)
patterns.rule: Three cascading red candles closing at absolute lows with negligible bottom shadows.

patterns.name: Identical Three Soldiers (Price Action)
patterns.rule: Three cascading green candles closing at absolute highs with negligible top shadows.

patterns.name: Identical Three Crows (Price Action)
patterns.rule: Pure momentum breakdown where successive open equals previous close without any hesitation.

patterns.name: Descent Block (Price Action)
patterns.rule: Decelerating red candles hitting deep liquidity pool, ready for immediate upward explosion.

patterns.name: Advance Block (Price Action)
patterns.rule: Decelerating green candles hitting heavy institutional sell orders, ready for sharp drop.

patterns.name: Three Line Strike Bullish (Pure)
patterns.rule: Massive engulfing green bar sweeps 3 red candles of liquidity and instantly breaks market structure upward.

patterns.name: Three Line Strike Bearish (Pure)
patterns.rule: Massive engulfing red bar sweeps 3 green candles of liquidity and instantly breaks market structure downward.

patterns.name: Three Stars in the South (Pure)
patterns.rule: Final selling exhaustion triangle candle formation terminating downtrend definitively.

patterns.name: Support Bounce Double Green
patterns.name_bn: সাপোর্ট থেকে পরপর ২টি সবুজ ক্যান্ডেল (Support Double Green)
patterns.rule: সাপোর্ট লেভেল বাউন্স করার পর পরপর দুটি শক্তিশালী সবুজ ক্যান্ডেল তৈরি হয়ে উপরে ক্লোজ হওয়া। নিশ্চিত আপট্রেন্ড শুরু (100% SureShot)।

patterns.name: Resistance Rejection Double Red
patterns.name_bn: রেজিস্ট্যান্স থেকে পরপর ২টি লাল ক্যান্ডেল (Resistance Double Red)
patterns.rule: রেজিস্ট্যান্স লেভেল রিজেক্ট করার পর পরপর দুটি শক্তিশালী লাল ক্যান্ডেল তৈরি হয়ে নিচে ক্লোজ হওয়া। নিশ্চিত ডাউনট্রেন্ড শুরু (100% SureShot)।
